supported_ir_domain: DecodedIR values for which decodeBytes succeeds, types enumerations are nonempty finite, state table is complete 32-or-declared-size nonnegative cells, registry ids unique, and step tags are invoke|issue|revoke
canonicality_hypothesis: RatEnc lowest terms den>0; objects use grammar canonical_nested_key_order; compact UTF-8; no duplicate keys
extensional_finite_world_equality: worldEq cells amounts and store.entries pointwise; not function extensionality over an infinite Domain

statements.name: encode_decode_roundtrip
statements.statement: ∀ (ir : DecodedIR), supported ir → canonical ir → decodeBytes (encodeModule ir) = .ok ir

statements.name: decode_encode_canonical_bytes
statements.statement: ∀ raw ir, decodeBytes raw = .ok ir → canonical ir → encodeModule ir is the unique compact canonical encoding of ir (not necessarily equal to raw if raw had key-order differences that decode accepted only after canonicalization — this increment refuses non-canonical key order at decode)

statements.name: checkIR_execute_ok
statements.statement: ∀ cert ir post, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir.mode = typed-execute → Typed.execute ir.registry ir.store ir.ctx ir.env ir.now ir.request ir.state = .ok post → (checkIR ir).status = .accepted ∧ worldEq (checkIR ir).world post

statements.name: checkIR_execute_error
statements.statement: ∀ cert ir r, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir.mode = typed-execute → Typed.execute ... = .error r → (checkIR ir).status = .refused ∧ (checkIR ir).failure = kernel r ∧ worldEq (checkIR ir).world ir.preState

statements.name: checkIR_executeStep_ok
statements.statement: ir.mode = composition-step → Composition.executeStep ... = .ok result → Report accepted and world/receipt/outputs equal result, receipt extracted from pre-state

statements.name: checkIR_executeStep_error
statements.statement: executeStep = .error f → Report refused with FailurePath f and world equal pre

statements.name: checkIR_run_cursor
statements.statement: ir.mode = composition-run → Report fields equal Composition.run cursor including events, outputs, nextIndex, cursorFailure and inert suffix

statements.name: decode_error_no_execute
statements.statement: decodeBytes raw = malformed/blocked → checkBytes raw is codec outcome and Typed.execute is not called

bounded_if_not_proved: If a statement is only computationally checked on fixtures, label it bounded and do not use it to discharge universal RC01.

audit.reason: AxiomAudit filters by defining-module prefix, not by transitive imports. Certificates import of Typed does not audit Typed theorems.
